label: The priests, the captain of the temple and the Sadducees arrested Peter and John and held them in custody
statement: As Peter and John spoke to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple (strategos tou hierou) and the Sadducees came upon them, laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

label: The Sadducees were upset because Peter and John proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection of the dead
statement: The authorities were upset (diaponoumenoi) because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead - the party that denies resurrection being provoked by resurrection preaching.

label: The number of the men who believed came to be about five thousand
statement: After the speech many who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand - a reported movement size, not externally attested.

label: The rulers, elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem the next morning
statement: On the next morning their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem - a session of the council (Sanhedrin) in the city.

label: Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander and the high priest's relatives were gathered
statement: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest. Annas was not the high priest de jure in the 30s (Caiaphas was); 'John' and 'Alexander' are otherwise unknown - 'John' has been identified with Jonathan son of Annas (a Beza-manuscript reading and some commentators), and Alexander with the Alabarch brother of Philo, 'without the shadow of evidence'.

label: The council stood Peter and John in the middle and inquired by what power or name they had acted
statement: The gathered council stood Peter and John in the middle and inquired, 'By what power, or in what name, have you done this?' - Peter answered concerning the good deed done to the crippled man.

label: Peter quoted the stone the builders rejected to the council
statement: Peter told the council: 'He is the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner' (Psalm 118:22).

label: The council perceived Peter and John as unlearned and ignorant men and recognized they had been with Jesus
statement: Seeing the boldness of Peter and John and perceiving that they were unlearned (agrammatoi) and ignorant men, the council marveled and recognized that they had been with Jesus.

label: The council commanded Peter and John not to speak or teach in the name of Jesus and let them go
statement: The council threatened them and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus; then, finding no way to punish them because of the people (all glorifying God for the healing), they let them go.

label: The man who was healed was more than forty years old
statement: The man on whom the miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old - an age note distinguishing him from the man lame 'from his mother's womb'.

label: The believers' prayer quoted Psalm 2 against the nations and rulers
statement: The prayer recalled David's words: 'Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing? The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ' (Psalm 2:1-2).

label: Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, were gathered against Jesus in this city
statement: The prayer recalled that 'in this city against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together' - the Passion actors listed together.

label: The believers were of one heart and soul and held all things in common
statement: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul; not one claimed that anything he possessed was his own, owners of lands or houses sold them, laid the proceeds at the apostles' feet, and distribution was made to each as anyone had need.

label: Barnabas (Joses), a Levite of Cyprus, sold a field and laid the money at the apostles' feet
statement: Joses, surnamed Barnabas (Son of Encouragement) by the apostles, a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race, having a field sold it and brought the money, laying it at the apostles' feet.

label: The captain of the temple was the officer over the temple watch
statement: The captain of the temple (strategos tou hierou) was a distinct temple office in Jerusalem, over the temple watch, acting with the priests and the Sadducees (Acts 4:1).

label: The Sadducees deny the resurrection
statement: The Sadducees, the party named in Acts 4:1, hold that there is no resurrection - the doctrine Josephus, Ant. 18.1.4, states as 'that souls die with the bodies'.

label: Wikisource: Josephus, Antiquities 18.1.4 (the doctrine of the Sadducees)

excerpt: But the doctrine of the Sadducees is this: That souls die with the bodies; nor do they regard the observation of any thing besides what the law enjoins them
